## Change Case

Add text to the start and/or end of every line (e.g. quotes, commas, bullet points).

```sh
dogubako text prefix-suffix <text> [options]
```

Id `text.prefix_suffix` · MCP `text_prefix_suffix` · Output: text (`text/plain`) · Timeout 2 min

Also found by: prefix, suffix, prepend, append, wrap lines, quote lines, bullet

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` *(required)* | positional | text (multi-line) |  |  |
| `prefix` | `--prefix` | text |  |  |
| `suffix` | `--suffix` | text |  |  |
| `skip_empty` | `--skip-empty` | boolean | `true` | Skip empty lines. |

## Filter Lines

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-native">native</span><span>live</span></div>

Keep (or remove) lines that contain a word, start/end with text or match a regular expression (like grep).

```sh
dogubako text filter-lines <text> --pattern <pattern> [options]
```

Id `text.filter_lines` · MCP `text_filter_lines` · Output: text (`text/plain`) · Timeout 2 min

Also found by: grep, filter, lines containing, remove lines, keep lines, search

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` *(required)* | positional | text (multi-line) |  |  |
| `pattern` *(required)* | `--pattern` | text |  |  |
| `match` | `--match` | choice | `contains` | One of: `contains`, `starts` (Starts with), `ends` (Ends with), `exact` (Equals), `regex` (Regular expression). |
| `invert` | `--invert` | boolean | `false` | Remove matching lines instead. |
| `case_insensitive` | `--case-insensitive` | boolean | `false` | Ignore case. |

## Unicode Inspector

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-native">native</span><span>live</span></div>

Show every character's code point, official Unicode name, category and UTF-8/UTF-16 encoding — find hidden or look-alike characters.

```sh
dogubako text unicode-inspect <text> [options]
```

Id `text.unicode_inspect` · MCP `text_unicode_inspect` · Output: structured data · Timeout 2 min

Also found by: unicode, code point, character, emoji, utf-8 bytes, hidden characters, homoglyph, char info

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` *(required)* | positional | text (multi-line) |  |  |
| `limit` | `--limit` | integer 1–20000 | `2000` | Max characters. *Advanced.* |

## Word Frequency

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-native">native</span><span>live</span></div>

Count how often each word appears and list the most frequent ones.

```sh
dogubako text word-frequency [text] [options]
```

Id `text.word_frequency` · MCP `text_word_frequency` · Output: structured data · Timeout 2 min

Also found by: word frequency, keyword density, top words, concordance, count words

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | positional | text (multi-line) |  |  |
| `file` | `--file` | file |  | Or upload a text file. |
| `top` | `--top` | integer ≥ 0 | `50` | Show top N (0 = all). |
| `min_length` | `--min-length` | integer 1–100 | `1` | Minimum word length. |
| `ignore_stopwords` | `--ignore-stopwords` | boolean | `false` | Ignore common English words. |

## Extract Text from Document

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-native">native</span></div>

Extract plain text from TXT, Markdown, HTML, JSON, CSV, DOCX, ODT, PPTX, ODP, XLSX/XLS/ODS, EPUB, RTF and PDF (PDF needs Poppler).

```sh
dogubako text extract <file> [options]
```

Id `text.extract` · MCP `text_extract` · Output: text (`text/plain`) · Timeout 5 min

Also found by: extract text, docx to text, word to text, epub, rtf, pptx, xlsx, odt, pdf to text, plain text

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `file` *(required)* | positional | file |  | Document. Accepts text/\*, .txt .md .html .htm .xhtml .json +15 more. |
| `width` | `--width` | integer 20–10000 | `100` | Line width for HTML-based formats. *Advanced.* |
